title: Comparative Characterization of sigma(32)-Dependent Promoters for the Heat-Inducible Expression of FAST-PETase in Escherichia coli.
authors: Limsakul, Praopim; Rasitanon, Natcha; Da-Oh, Sahban; Phongdara, Amornrat; Nualla-Ong, Aekkaraj; Charupanit, Krit
one_liner_zh: 该文比较sigma(32)依赖型热诱导启动子并用于FAST-PETase表达，虽涉及sigma因子-DNA互作和分子对接，但核心是启动子工程应用，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Efficient regulation of recombinant enzyme expression is an important consideration for the development of microbial biocatalysts. Heat-inducible promoters regulated by the alternative sigma factor sigma(32) provide an inducer-free strategy for controlling gene expression in Escherichia coli. In this study, four sigma(32)-dependent promoters (PdnaK, PgrpE, PibpA, and PclpB) were comparatively characterized using the PET-degrading enzyme FAST-PETase fused to superfolder green fluorescent protein as a model recombinant protein. Promoter performance was evaluated based on basal leakage, induction kinetics, and expression strength following heat induction. Among the promoters examined, PdnaK exhibited the strongest heat-inducible expression and was dissected to examine the autonomous and combinatorial behavior of its promoter-derived elements. Molecular docking analysis further supported the experimental observations by showing qualitative agreement between predicted sigma(32)-DNA interactions and promoter performance. Together, these findings provide a comparative characterization of sigma(32)-dependent promoters and identify promoter architectures that may facilitate the development of heat-inducible recombinant enzyme expression systems in E. coli.
abstract_zh: 重组酶表达的高效调控是微生物生物催化剂开发中的重要考量。由替代sigma因子sigma(32)调控的热诱导启动子为大肠杆菌中的基因表达提供了一种无诱导剂的控制策略。本研究以PET降解酶FAST-PETase融合超折叠绿色荧光蛋白作为模型重组蛋白，对四个sigma(32)依赖性启动子（PdnaK、PgrpE、PibpA和PclpB）进行了比较性表征。启动子性能基于基础泄漏、诱导动力学和热诱导后的表达强度进行评估。在所检查的启动子中，PdnaK表现出最强的热诱导表达，并对其进行了剖析，以检查其启动子衍生元件的自主和组合行为。分子对接分析进一步支持了实验观察结果，显示预测的sigma(32)-DNA相互作用与启动子性能之间存在定性一致性。综合这些发现，提供了对sigma(32)依赖性启动子的比较性表征，并识别了可能促进大肠杆菌中热诱导重组酶表达系统开发的启动子架构。
